scripts.dev: cross-env NODE_ENV=development concurrently -k --prefix none "rspeedy dev --environment lynx" "dev-ready-rspeedy && rsbuild dev --environment desktop"
scripts.build: rspeedy build --environment lynx && rsbuild build --environment desktop
scripts.dev:web: cross-env NODE_ENV=development concurrently -k --prefix node "rspeedy dev --environment web" "dev-ready-rspeedy && rsbuild dev --environment web"
scripts.build:web: rspeedy build --environment web && rsbuild build --environment web
scripts.start:web: npm run build:web && npx serve dist/web
scripts.prepare:mobile: rspeedy build --environment lynx && npm --prefix ../lynxtron-mobile run build && node ./src/main/mobile/scripts/sync-bundle.mjs
scripts.build:mobile:android: npm run prepare:mobile && npm --prefix ./src/main/mobile run build:android -- --emulator
scripts.build:mobile:ios: npm run prepare:mobile && npm --prefix ./src/main/mobile run build:ios -- --emulator
scripts.start:mobile:android: npm run prepare:mobile && npm --prefix ./src/main/mobile run android -- --emulator
scripts.start:mobile:ios: npm run prepare:mobile && npm --prefix ./src/main/mobile run ios -- --emulator
